_comment: Shows resource scoping. The admin may SetIamPolicy only on projects/demo (not '*'). A project-level grant also reaches child buckets via the hierarchy, but nothing outside projects/demo. Witnesses are pinned to a resource the principal can actually touch.
_expect: blindspots resourcemanager.projects.setIamPolicy  ->  reachable ON projects/demo; any witness event uses that resource, never a project the admin can't reach.
The child bucket //storage.../buckets/secrets inherits projects/demo, so a bucket-scoped question still resolves through the hierarchy.
name: scoped-grant
